# Theme controller

**Status:** available. **Category:** actions. **In the demo:** `/gallery/theme-controller`.

> On its own it changes the theme without saving it, and it cannot say that the theme should follow the system. The shell uses its class inside a form that saves the choice: see Settings.

This repository's rules come first. Where this page disagrees with [Standards](../standards.md) or
[AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md), they win: no CDN, no npm, no images from other servers, no inline `style` or `onclick`.
Use the [macros](../../../app/ui/templates/ui/macros.html) where one exists.

If a checked checkbox or radio input has the `theme-controller` class, the page uses the theme in the input value.

[Theme controller documentation](https://daisyui.com/components/theme-controller/)

## Class names
- component: `theme-controller`

## Syntax
```html
<input type="checkbox" value="{theme-name}" class="theme-controller" />
```

## Rules
- The `value` attribute of the input element must contain a valid daisyUI theme name.
